findings.issue: The '*', INPUT_UNIT and OUTPUT_UNIT equality facets ('the same as the unit identified by ...') were planned through stdin/stdout capture and separate controls, which observe compatible effects, not unit identity.
findings.resolution: Recorded as no portable oracle. 12.5.4: 'It is processor dependent whether a file can be connected to more than one unit at the same time' and 'If input/output operations are performed on more than one unit while they are connected to the same external file, the results are processor dependent.' Record-order continuity therefore cannot distinguish one unit from two units sharing a file, and INQUIRE NAME= (only defined if the file has a name) and NUMBER= (processor dependent which unit is reported) do not rescue it.
